laws.name: AX-RESOLVE-OVER-PIXEL-GUESS
laws.statement: Resolve targets from the accessibility tree (exact bounds, clickability) and act on those; never let a vision brain guess pixel coordinates (measured: pixel-guess missed by 1009px; small-text pixel misreads confirmed twice; AX exact).
laws.scope: Tapping/reading UI on embodied surfaces (WebView measured; native apps Unproven). Absorbs SMALL-TEXT-PIXEL law (vision endowment) as second measurement.

laws.name: NORMALIZE-AT-BOUNDARY
laws.statement: Normalize verb case/aliases at the harness boundary; the action lattice stays canonical inside.
laws.scope: Actuator harness input parsing (vendor returned 'Tap' vs grammar 'tap').

laws.name: ONE-CANONICAL-MIRROR-SHAPE
laws.statement: Every file in dashboard/static/lattices/ is produced only by mag.lattice_logic export with shape {schema: lattice_logic.v1, entries: [...]}; raw copies are forbidden (measured: cp collapsed 47 entries into 1 walked entry).
laws.scope: dashboard/static/lattices/* mirrors; any future static lattice export.

laws.name: TRUNCATION-BURN
laws.statement: Treat empty-content-at-token-cap (finish=length, no error field) as a quota-BURNING failure, not a clean empty: set max_tokens above the realistic answer budget (vision-exp cap now 1200) and count the burned tokens.
laws.scope: Vision/LLM calls with max_tokens caps, especially free-lane vision models.

laws.name: SHARED-RIG-DRIFT
laws.statement: On shared rigs every prep self-heals to the expected surface (tap the home button) and every run raises on null ground truth — never score against a drifted environment.
laws.scope: emulator-5554 and any surface more than one driver can navigate.

laws.name: PILL-CONCATENATION
laws.statement: Inject delimiters between concatenated AX spans in the transducer; never hand a small model unsegmented pill text ('generic entries47 entriesinvariants.json').
laws.scope: AX/accessibility-tree text serialization feeding small models.
laws.consumer: see()/transducer output format (fix belongs in the tool, not the model)

laws.name: TRANSDUCER-PREFERENCE
laws.statement: Offer the structure channel first and label both channels; dumb models prefer the tree when both are available (measured 5/5 chose 'ui').
laws.scope: Endowment tool design; observation-grade (n=5 tasks, one page).

laws.name: QUESTION-TEMPLATE
laws.statement: Task wording is part of the transducer surface: state answer formats exactly and idiomatically — dumb models read templates literally and will pour wrong data into a literal template.
laws.scope: Harness question authoring for small models (t4 exhibit: coords poured into 'pos X/Y').

laws.name: POLL-NOT-PUSH
laws.statement: z.ai exposes zero webhook/callback surface (86/86 mirror pages, 14 openapi paths): own the polling loop; never wait for a push that cannot come — the vendor concedes orchestration to us.
laws.scope: All z.ai API integrations (async doors are FIRE then POLL).
laws.consumer: scheduler organ; day_work scheduler; any agent calling z.ai async

laws.name: HONEST-AUTH-WALL
laws.statement: Never fake past an auth wall (login/captcha): name the wall, stop, escalate to the operator — steal the vendor's Take_over primitive pattern into every fleet actuator spec.
laws.scope: Embodied/web actuators hitting credentials, captchas, consent screens.

laws.name: JUDGE-THEN-CAS
laws.statement: Commit takeovers by compare-and-swap on the target's identity token: re-read at commit and act only on exact token match; on any race lose honestly with zero writes (split-brain closed: exactly 1 winner per contended round).
laws.scope: bay claim organ stale-takeover; window throttle takeover; any file-based claim commit.

laws.name: LEASE-OUTLIVES-CLAIMANT
laws.statement: A lease can outlive its claimant: expiry or proven staleness — not pid liveness alone — governs takeover; pid is attribution. Judge staleness at takeover; never trust that a present claim is live.
laws.scope: Claim leases everywhere (bay claims: grace+pid-death variant; window throttle: expiry-only variant, claim outlives claimant — builder receipt-002 lease law).

laws.name: TWO-STRIKE-AMENDED
laws.statement: Two strikes kill the DOOR, not the task: switch lane/approach and keep driving (retries near-free); bail only on operator attention, judgment-seat context, clock, or no-new-information — bail on boredom, not on cost.
laws.scope: All seats/lanes, all retries. Supersedes scarcity-era original (original tombstoned into this row's lineage). Abundance premise is a LANE claim: flash/bay abundant, premium seat-lane scarce until discipline lands (economist stamp).

laws.name: OUTPUT-RATIO
laws.statement: Retire any automation/session whose useful-output divided by billed-tokens < 0.01 over rolling 24h (zombie-tick exhibit: would have killed it day one).
laws.scope: Every automation and long session; premium lanes first. Origin: watch/USAGE_METER_SELF_STEAL_20260904.md law 1.
laws.consumer: usage meter + nightly usage-db sweep organ (salon direction item 2)

laws.name: CONTEXT-DEBT
laws.statement: Compaction + context re-feed must stay <= 3x peak useful output; retire beyond.
laws.scope: Long conversations and looped agents. Origin: watch/USAGE_METER_SELF_STEAL_20260904.md law 3.
laws.consumer: lane manifest budget guards; judgment-seat hygiene

laws.name: HEARTBEAT-THROTTLE
laws.statement: Heartbeats are budgeted burns: 'exit fast' is not free when context re-feed dominates; budget heartbeat cadence against useful output.
laws.scope: Scheduled loops, watchers, daemons. Origin: watch/USAGE_METER_SELF_STEAL_20260904.md law 4.

laws.name: MODEL-PIN-ISOLATION
laws.statement: Subagents never inherit premium pins; default every spawn to the cheapest capable lane.
laws.scope: All subagent spawns. Origin: watch/USAGE_METER_SELF_STEAL_20260904.md law 2.

laws.name: MODEL-PIN-EXPIRY
laws.statement: A premium pin >72h without a completed task auto-demotes to the cheap lane.
laws.scope: Premium lane pins (z_ai2-class). No enforcing organ yet — beyond the mission's named sources, disclosed in the receipt.

laws.name: CITE-VERIFY
laws.statement: A citation is a claim until byte-checked against its source (ns-3 fake-citation exhibit); grok's auto-sourced captures are the cheapest verify lane.
laws.scope: Research outputs, salon witnesses, any agent citing a source.
laws.consumer: research lane verify pass; intake organ

laws.name: TRAIL-DISCIPLINE
laws.statement: Every lane action lands as a trail row (ts/actor/event/detail/artifacts) same-turn; trails/surfaces/digests are files on disk, mirrored — no era gets lost again.
laws.scope: All lanes and seats. Append-only is convention until LAW-043 hash-chaining lands.

laws.name: RECEIPTS-HAVE-HYPOTHESES
laws.statement: Every receipt states its hypothesis and a tri-state verdict (Supported/Disputed/Unproven) with evidence attached; thinking is evidence of method, not law itself.
laws.scope: watch/ cards, salon folds, run receipts.

laws.name: SACRED-COWS-NOT-LEGACY-SHIT
laws.statement: Old daemons/drafts are one draft of the brain: steal the bones, name the reinterpretation, retire the draft — never frame fleet history as garbage.
laws.scope: All self-steal and retirement work (operator-corrected standing law).

laws.name: TOPOLOGY-LAW
laws.statement: Android fleet: one golden body — never clone logins (canon account at stake); UI-as-API; bodies are the embodied lane's field office (2 live, 4 fit).
laws.scope: android_surface lane; AVD/emulator management.

laws.name: CUTOFF-HONESTY
laws.statement: State knowledge limits in ONE line and keep driving structurally sound reasoning; never confabulate past a cutoff (blind-7B honest refusals = the baseline pattern).
laws.scope: All answer composition under knowledge limits.

laws.name: DEFINE-THE-NEGATIVE-SPACE
laws.statement: Before proposing X, enumerate what counts as NOT-X so the boundary is structural, not a vibe.
laws.scope: Research/scouting missions; rubric definitions.

laws.name: STRUCTURAL-OVER-TEMPORAL
laws.statement: Under knowledge limits, rank candidates by structural persistence (likely to remain so) over recency claims.
laws.scope: Signal-source selection; restock missions.

laws.name: LEADING-INDICATOR-PREFERENCE
laws.statement: Score signal sources by how EARLY the signal fires (certs before press, filings before calls, downloads before coverage).
laws.scope: Signal-source ranking.

laws.name: DISCARD-TRACKING
laws.statement: The thinking is wider than the answer: capture the cut list too — ingest both the verbatim thinking and the answer (FT loop harvests both).
laws.scope: FT ingest loop; salon distills.

laws.name: OUTPUT-BUDGET-DISCIPLINE
laws.statement: Restate the user's format contract to yourself before composing; enforce via a format gate where machine-checkable.
laws.scope: All composing agents; harness format gates.

laws.name: MANIFEST-AT-SPAWN
laws.statement: The lane manifest is read once at spawn, never at runtime; invariants live in files, not in-process memory.
laws.scope: All 7 lanes (LAWS block). Convention until MCP_MANIFEST_SPEC enforces at spawn.

laws.name: INBOX-POINTERS-ONLY
laws.statement: Inbox rows are compact pointers; payloads live in the files the pointer names.
laws.scope: All lane inboxes (jsonl).

laws.name: SURFACE-BROWSE-TARGET
laws.statement: The lane surface is the operator's browse target: populate at every phase change; never idle with a stub surface.
laws.scope: All lane surfaces (+ dashboard mirrors).

laws.name: ONE-SCHEDULER-ORGAN
laws.statement: All timers live in ONE scheduler organ; a lane cannot run its own cron — architectural absence is the enforcement.
laws.scope: Whole fleet (respawn law kin: no second supervisors).

laws.name: MCP-WHITELIST
laws.statement: A lane may call only the MCP servers named in its manifest.
laws.scope: All lanes (fair-use firewall kin).

laws.name: TRI-STATE-RECEIPTS
laws.statement: No receipt = never happened: every completed action carries a tri-state receipt (Supported/Disputed/Unproven) before the arc closes.
laws.scope: All lanes; today a logging convention — hardens via LAW-037 gate.

laws.name: KILL-WORD
laws.statement: Manager fires 'KILL <NAME>': the lane flushes its inbox, writes a KILLED receipt, and exits.
laws.scope: All lanes. Kill-switch designed, never fired — untested physics; keep the path warm.

laws.name: HANDOFF-GATE
laws.statement: Every inbox drop is validated atomically at transfer (tri-state receipt + policy check + budget check) before the lane acts on it.
laws.scope: All lane inboxes (clause 9, v1.1). In manifests as convention; enforcement build pending.

laws.name: ASK-BUDGET
laws.statement: Asking the operator early is a sanctioned, receipted SENSING action with its own allocation — never a demerit, never a stall condition.
laws.scope: All lanes (clause 10, v1.1). DISPUTED: the stall-ladder organ (stall->nudge->worth-eval->kill) still counts asking as stalling — live conflict until LAW-048 counter lands.

laws.name: CHAN-COMMS
laws.statement: Lanes talk to each other through the chan surface: typed rows {from_lane,to_lane,msg,ref} appended to watch/room.jsonl; the manager answers IN LINE, not only in batched digests. Speed over comfort: use the tools the task needs.
laws.scope: All lanes + manager (clause 11, v1.2).

laws.name: RESEARCH-SAME-TURN
laws.statement: Dropped links process SAME TURN (score/route/launch), run in background, surface at every phase change; duplication of long digs is emphasis (cross-verification). Never wait idle with a stub surface.
laws.scope: Research lane charter amendment. Measured FAILING as prose (forgotten 3x — architecture card tier-1 exhibit): flagged, hardener = LAW-044.

laws.name: STRUCTURE-IS-LAW
laws.statement: Enforce by physics first (structural: violation impossible or instantly self-evident), then runtime checks, then prose; move every Tier-1 law down a tier and harden Tier-2 to Tier-3 — every law that worked today was structural, every failure was prose.
laws.scope: The meta-law: all law authoring and audits (this lattice follows it via the enforcement field).
laws.consumer: this lattice; evals lane; redesign candidates below

laws.name: MACHINE-CHECKABLE-OR-DECORATIVE
laws.statement: A law whose condition is prose is decorative to a machine (measured: 8/8 law-registry conditions unfirable by lattice_logic chain()): law conditions go structured as they are touched — the Evals lane's first KPI.
laws.scope: The law registry, this lattice's conditions, invariant checks. Same finding in dogfood card + salon blind spot + company-design open wound (deduped into this row).

laws.name: HASH-CHAINED-TRAILS
laws.statement: Each trail row commits to the prior row's hash (verkle for trails) so rewriting history is self-evident, not trusted — append-only becomes physics.
laws.scope: All trails. Candidate (Unproven) pending the physical-computing field fold.

laws.name: STRUCTURAL-SURFACE-POPULATION
laws.statement: The scheduler writes interim state to any lane surface whose trail grows while its surface stays stale — population stops being the agent's choice.
laws.scope: Lane surfaces; fixes the LAW-032/LAW-040 class of prose failures. Candidate (Unproven).

laws.name: DELETE-AS-APPEND
laws.statement: Nothing deletes silently: removals are moves-to-tomb with receipts (claims organ already does this — generalize to every destructive act).
laws.scope: Claims today; general destructive ops candidate. Backup-first on ground-truth surgery is the standing kin.

laws.name: CAPABILITY-CHECKED-INBOXES
laws.statement: An inbox drop without a valid handoff-gate row is invisible to the lane — unreadable by construction.
laws.scope: Lane inboxes; structural hardening of LAW-037. Candidate (Unproven).
laws.consumer: lane inbox readers; MCP_MANIFEST_SPEC spawn gate

laws.name: TIME-UNFAKEABLE-ROWS
laws.statement: Receipts carry chain-anchored (RFC-3161-style) timestamps so 'when' cannot be backdated.
laws.scope: Receipts/trails. Candidate; chain gives this nearly free but needs a design pass — SHELVED to the REEMBER shelf.

laws.name: ASK-BUDGET-COUNTER
laws.statement: A monotonic per-lane counter enforces the ask allocation: asking decrements it; the stall-ladder cannot see sanctioned asking as failure because the counter says it is sanctioned.
laws.scope: All lanes; resolves the LAW-038 vs stall-ladder dispute. Candidate (Unproven).

laws.name: RESTOCK-FIRST
laws.statement: Food (genuinely new signal) is the binding constraint: research mandate is restock-first on NEW domains, archaeology secondary (orphans folded; rereading our own mail was a one-time recovery); sweeps retire at diminishing returns (shift-5+ theater).
laws.scope: Research lane mandate (salon-unanimous + economist concur with lane-scope caveat). Manifest edit pending.
laws.consumer: research manifest mandate flip; HUNGER_LEDGER instrument

laws.name: WINDOW-PRIMARY-CLAIM
laws.statement: One primary per work window, claimed by file: claim via atomic create with judge-then-CAS takeover and expiry-only lease (race-verified, 154 checks, 0 failures).
laws.scope: Night windows 23:00-09:00 and any multi-booked window; launch-law same-turn builders.

laws.name: FOUR-VERB-STANDARD
laws.statement: Every orphan/lesson/root gets all four verbs — WIRE (named consumer), TRANSDUCE (structure not prose), DISPOSE (FOLDED/TOMBSTONED/ROUTED/SHELVED, in the digest), SUBSTRATE (queryable/append-only/read-at-spawn); prose is the input format, never the storage format.
laws.scope: All normalization work (this run is its first enforcement). Disclosed: +1 beyond the mission's named source list.
laws.consumer: THE_NORMALIZER standard; day digests; this lattice

laws.name: COUNSEL-ADVISES-FOUNDER-RULES
laws.statement: Legal verdicts are recorded advice, never gates; the founder's overrule is receipted and supreme.
laws.scope: counsel windows

laws.name: RIDDLER GATE
laws.statement: External-surface missions carrying fleet internals route through mag/riddler.py (semantic surrogate; the mapping never leaves the machine).
laws.scope: intake organ sensors

laws.name: DISCOVERED-INVARIANTS
laws.statement: Harvested rules/method/thinking are discoveries of existing invariants, not property; reading our own rendered DOM and keeping it is sanctioned; training corpus stays license-clean for provenance (our interest).
laws.scope: frontier-thinking harvest

laws.name: HUMAN-PACED WINDOWS
laws.statement: External surfaces get human-paced rates, session spread, and volume patterns indistinguishable from the founder own usage — camouflage-craft as pure operations, never compliance theater.
laws.source: operator ruling 09-04 (napkin-cited): do not get us banned; refuse orwellian framing
laws.scope: intake organ external sensors

laws.name: COUNTER-TEETH
laws.statement: Any economist premium/RED flag that survives two scheduler fires without action escalates AUTOMATICALLY to the operator inbox (zcode INBOX row + digest headline). Advice without escalation after 2 fires is a lane failure, not an operator miss.
laws.scope: economist flags + scheduler

laws.name: THE TEN-MINUTE SURFACE
laws.statement: Before any task is accepted, the seat names the exact window/control it will arm in the operator UI within 10 minutes - no charter, no card, no mirror. If it cannot name the concrete surface it will touch, it does not start.
laws.scope: all seats, all verbs

laws.name: PIN-CHECK-BEFORE-WORK
laws.statement: Before doing model-work, a session reads its own pin; a premium-pinned session with flash available REFUSES bulk work and redirects to a flash-born surface. Killing instances never fixes classes - the hosting session is the habitat.
laws.scope: all sessions
